title: Great Ideas in Theoretical Computer Science

headline.question: how hard is 15-251, what is the workload, and is it worth it?
headline.answer_md:
## 15-251 (Great Theoretical Ideas in CS): Difficulty, Workload & Worth It?

### Difficulty
The course is broadly considered challenging. One student described it plainly: "15-251 was certainly a tricky course" [bowad-15-251-7#0 · bowad — course reviews · Fall 2022 · https://bowad.net/courses/]. A first-person account of struggling is worth quoting directly:

> "I struggled in 15-251 and 15-150. I found that all of my classes this semester were taught well, although I do not think I retained the full amount of material from both 15-251 and 15-150 due to being overwhelmed about workload." [abigalekim-15-251-16#0 · Abigale Kim — course reviews · Spring 2019 · https://abigalekim.github.io/courses/]

### Workload
The evidence above signals that workload is a real concern — particularly when taken alongside other demanding courses like 15-150. The overwhelm described suggests the course is not light, even if the teaching quality is high.

### Professor-by-Professor Breakdown (RMP)
- **Anil Ada**: 4.8/5 overall, 95% would take again, difficulty rated **3.9/5** (22 ratings) [rmp-anilada-15-251#0 · RateMyProfessors — Anil Ada · 2026-08 · https://www.ratemyprofessors.com/professor/1981067]
- **Venkatesan Guruswami**: 5/5 overall, 100% would take again, difficulty rated **5/5** (1 rating — very small sample) [rmp-venkatesanguruswami-15-251#0 · RateMyProfessors — Venkatesan Guruswami · 2026-08 · https://www.ratemyprofessors.com/professor/2450313]
- **Vipul Goyal**: 3.3/5 overall, 50% would take again, difficulty rated **3.3/5** (4 ratings) [rmp-vipulgoyal-15-251#0 · RateMyProfessors — Vipul Goyal · 2026-08 · https://www.ratemyprofessors.com/professor/2450314]

### Is It Worth It?
The evidence leans yes — especially with the right professor. As one student put it, the "quality of the lectures and course materials is very high" and Ada "perhaps made the entire course" for them [bowad-15-251-7#0 · bowad — course reviews · Fall 2022 · https://bowad.net/courses/].

### Conflicts & Caveats
- The Guruswami difficulty rating of 5/5 is based on **only 1 rating** — treat with caution.
- The Abigale Kim review is from **Spring 2019**, which may not reflect current course structure.
- Goyal's 50% "would take again" is a meaningful dissent from the otherwise positive picture.

### Source Mix
- 📊 RateMyProfessors (3 professors)
- 📝 Personal course review blogs (2 sources: bowad, Abigale Kim)

**Recommendation:** 15-251 is genuinely hard and workload-heavy — be cautious about pairing it with other theory-heavy courses. If you can take it with **Anil Ada**, the evidence strongly suggests it's worth it. Avoid overloading your schedule the same semester.

## 15-251: Conceptual Difficulty vs. Grind?

The available evidence doesn't give a clean "conceptual vs. grind" breakdown, but it does offer some useful signals:

**It's described as genuinely tricky (not just busywork):**
One student wrote: "15-251 was certainly a tricky course, but the quality of the lectures and course materials is very high." [bowad-15-251-7#0 · bowad — course reviews · Fall 2022 · https://bowad.net/courses/]

This framing ("tricky") points more toward conceptual challenge than pure volume grinding.

**Workload is also a real factor:**
A first-person account directly contradicts any pure "it's just hard concepts" framing — one student wrote: "I struggled in 15-251 and 15-150. I found that all of my classes this semester were taught well, although I do not think I retained the full amount of material from both 15-251 and 15-150 due to being overwhelmed about workload." [abigalekim-15-251-16#0 · Abigale Kim — course reviews · Spring 2019 · https://abigalekim.github.io/courses/]

This suggests **both** are real concerns — the course is conceptually demanding *and* the workload volume can overwhelm you.

**Difficulty ratings by professor:**
- Venkatesan Guruswami: difficulty **5/5** [rmp-venkatesanguruswami-15-251#0 · RateMyProfessors — Venkatesan Guruswami · 2026-08 · https://www.ratemyprofessors.com/professor/2450313] (only 1 rating — treat with caution)
- Anil Ada: difficulty **3.9/5** [rmp-anilada-15-251#0 · RateMyProfessors — Anil Ada · 2026-08 · https://www.ratemyprofessors.com/professor/1981067]
- Vipul Goyal: difficulty **3.3/5** [rmp-vipulgoyal-15-251#0 · RateMyProfessors — Vipul Goyal · 2026-08 · https://www.ratemyprofessors.com/professor/2450314]

**Source mix:** RMP (3 entries), personal course-review blogs (2 entries). No Reddit in this evidence set. The blog sources are somewhat old (Spring 2019, Fall 2022).

**Bottom line:** The evidence points to **both** conceptual difficulty *and* workload volume being real. It's not purely a grind course — "tricky" conceptual content is a consistent theme — but the volume is heavy enough that students report being overwhelmed even when the teaching quality is high. Your experience will likely vary by professor, with Guruswami's section rated hardest (though that's based on just 1 rating).
